description: Runs SniffPup's free passive scan of a live website (takes up to about a minute) and returns the score and the issues found. Every critical issue comes with masked evidence, fix steps and a fix prompt (with no critical issue, one other issue does). Only scan a site the user owns or has permission to test, and set consent to true only after the user confirms: I own this site or can test it, and agree to the Terms, including individual arbitration.

consent.description: true only if the user confirmed: I own this site or can test it, and agree to the Terms, including individual arbitration.

url.description: The live site to scan, like https://your-app.com or your-app.com.
